theme: Landed in Dubrovnik — two days of shore before the boat.
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik, checked into the apartment above the Old Port through Friday. Before the charter takes you offline Saturday, a short list wants dry land.

needsAttention.title: Kerrie's waiting on the AI paper
needsAttention.detail: After you sent the whistleblower document, Kerrie Waring replied asking for the AI paper you'd referred to. A quick send closes it before the boat cuts your signal.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus charter details
needsAttention.detail: Boarding time and location for Saturday, plus the return transfer to the airport on the 19th, still aren't confirmed with the instructor. Sort it from shore while you have connectivity.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: The room's booked, but the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, the early bag hold, and the 5 AM Sunday checkout all need arranging from dry land before you board — and free cancellation ends Sept 15.

schedule.title: Flight to Dubrovnik
schedule.detail: Frankfurt to Dubrovnik, LH 4296 — the last leg in.

flagged.title: Clarke appliance invoice due
flagged.detail: Clarke Customer Care sent the invoice for the July 31 repair.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Yvonne
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn message from Yvonne is sitting unanswered — worth a look for who it is.

flagged.title: Mike still wants a call on Nomura
flagged.detail: The Valoris-Nomura intermediaries thread has gone quiet since last week; Mike Lubrano flagged that you two still need to talk.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel logistics — Airbnb and Booking.com confirmations, boarding passes, a PayPal receipt, a Chase payment notice.

resolved.title: Carol Hansell call parked until after the trip
resolved.detail: You offered to talk before leaving; Carol replied 'Happy sailing, let's talk when you're back,' so it's set for after the 19th.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's early apples are crisp and abundant now — the season made for baking.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car outright
Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 landing gap

acts.line: The last leg out of Frankfurt, wheels down in Dubrovnik by early afternoon.
Into the apartment above the Old Port, yours through Friday.
Settle in — the charter boards Saturday, so the next two days belong to Dubrovnik.
